visual_identity.lighting: warm natural light with restrained contrast; late-afternoon or early-morning warmth when compatible with the current passage
visual_identity.material_language: stone, woven textile, leather, tent fabric, desert vegetation and ancient Near Eastern domestic materials when supported by the passage
visual_identity.left_panel_character: deep indigo-to-earth dark field with subtle antique texture and restrained gold/ivory accents

thematic_continuity: promise becoming concrete in people and place

scene_world.geographic_register: Canaan, Negev, northern Mesopotamian journey routes, wells, burial landscape, pastoral settlements and arid transition zones only when the current aliyah supports them
scene_world.architecture: tents, stone structures, wells, burial caves, pastoral encampments or settlements only when passage-specific
scene_world.costume: plain ancient Near Eastern garments with natural fibers and earth-toned textiles
scene_world.animals: camels, sheep, goats or pack animals only when passage-specific
scene_world.people: depict only persons or groups supported by the current aliyah; do not force recurring characters into every image

avoid: modern Middle Eastern clothing presented as exact biblical costume
ornamental religious symbolism not in the passage
romanticized palace imagery unless textually required
visual motifs imported from another parasha
forcing Sarah, Abraham, Isaac, Rebekah, Ishmael or any other named figure into a scene when the current aliyah does not depict them
current_run_override_rule: The current run image package controls persons, actions, place, time, theme and scene content. This parasha profile controls only visual continuity and may never override passage fidelity.
